notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 4 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
"White" or "Blue" chosen with Painter's Servant.
description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0} due to Will's ability.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
